description: Header file defining the DateCalculatorViewModel class, which manages date calculation logic and properties for a Windows app, including date difference and offset properties, and methods for updating display results.

classes.name: DateCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged, managing date calculation properties and logic for a Windows app.

methods.name: OnCopyCommand
methods.description: Handles copy command action, likely copying date results to clipboard.

methods.description: Raises property changed notifications for data binding.

methods.description: Updates the display strings based on current date calculations.

methods.description: Updates automation name for date result.
